name: MINI-EX v3
method_summary: MINI-EX infers plant cell-type-specific GRNs from scRNA-seq by first building a GRNBoost2 expression network, then filtering regulons with TF motif enrichment and cluster-specific target/TF expression. It prioritizes retained regulons using network centrality, median coexpression, TF/TG cluster specificity and optional GO-term-guided Borda ranking.

threading.upstream_mapping: Wrapper maps ANDREA --threads to Nextflow process cpus for MINI-EX run_grnboost; upstream passes task.cpus to MINIEX_runGrnboost.py as num_workers for multiprocessing.Pool. The wrapper keeps the GRNBoost2 subjob count as an internal technical default and pins BLAS/OpenMP inner threads to 1 to avoid nested oversubscription. When a precomputed grnboost_network is supplied, the GRNBoost2 worker stage is skipped and extra threads may not affect runtime.

required.usage: Wrapper converts groups.tsv to MINI-EX cellsToClusters input, mapping expression cell barcodes to cluster IDs used for cluster-specific regulon filtering and output contexts.
Wrapper preserves Seurat-style cluster_markers.tsv as MINI-EX allMarkers input; MINI-EX uses marker genes and adjusted p-values for cluster enrichment filtering and ranking.

Wrapper converts cluster_identities.tsv to MINI-EX clustersToIdentities input, mapping cluster IDs to biological labels; optional normalized order values are validated but omitted from the upstream file because MINI-EX v3.2 downstream scripts read this input as two columns.
Wrapper converts tf_list.txt to MINI-EX's TF list used by the GRNBoost2 step to restrict candidate regulators before MINI-EX ranking and filtering.

optional.usage: Optional GO or keyword list passed to MINI-EX termsOfInterest; when present, MINI-EX can use term-guided ranking of enriched regulators.
Optional gene universe passed to MINI-EX enrichmentBackground; when absent, the wrapper leaves it null so upstream defaults to expressed genes.
Optional precomputed GRNBoost2 network converted to MINI-EX grnboostOut format; when provided, the workflow skips de novo GRNBoost2 inference.

progress.note: The public Nextflow workflow exposes named processes and GRNBoost2 subjobs, but not a stable target-gene callback; the wrapper should report coarse process/task-partition progress in progress.json.

reference_species.description: Built-in MINI-EX species annotation set used for motif, alias and GO files. Use none only with doMotifAnalysis=false; then GO-guided ranking is unavailable.

doMotifAnalysis.description: Whether to run MINI-EX step 2 motif enrichment filtering. Upstream recommends true when motif data are available and allows false for unsupported species.

motifFilter.description: Motif filtering strictness for step 2: TF-F_motifs keeps TF-family motif-supported regulons, while TF_motifs keeps only direct TF motif-supported regulons.

topMarkers.description: Number of upregulated marker genes per cluster used for cluster enrichment filtering in step 3a.

expressionFilter.description: Minimum percentage of cells in a cluster that must express a TF for the regulon to be retained in step 3b.

topRegulons.description: Number of top regulons per cluster shown in MINI-EX output figures; upstream documents this as visualization-only and not affecting GRNs or ranking.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from the MINI-EX Nextflow run.
Generated Nextflow config used for the wrapper run.
Upstream GRNBoost2 output directory, either generated by MINI-EX or converted from the provided grnboost_network input.
Upstream MINI-EX regulon outputs, including edge table, regulons, TF info and ranked regulon metadata.
Upstream MINI-EX visualization outputs when generated for the run.
Upstream GO enrichment outputs when GO annotations and terms of interest are active.

compatibility_rules.message: MINI-EX motif analysis is only supported for the declared supported plant species; set doMotifAnalysis=false for unsupported plant taxa.
MINI-EX will run without motif analysis for an unsupported plant taxon; motif and GO-guided evidence will be unavailable.
reference_species=none cannot be used with doMotifAnalysis=true because no motif reference is available.
